name: Gulfstream G280
summary: Super-midsize Gulfstream built with IAI in Israel; the smallest jet in the current Gulfstream line.

wings: Low swept wing with upturned winglets
engines: Two Honeywell HTF7250G turbofans in pods on the rear fuselage
fuselage: Large oval windows on a medium-length fuselage
tail: T-tail with a swept fin and swept horizontal stabilizer

tellTales: Large oval windows on a medium-size twinjet with a T-tail
Upturned winglets on a swept wing
Long pointed nose and fairly slim fuselage

confusedWith.howToTell: The G280 has big oval windows; the Challenger 300/350 has rounded-rectangle windows.
The G280 is much smaller with fewer oval windows and HTF7250G engines; the GIV/G550 is a long-range large jet with a much longer fuselage.
The G280 has oval windows; the Praetor/Legacy 500 has rounded-rectangle windows.
The G280 has oval windows on a slimmer fuselage; the Latitude/Longitude has rounded-rectangle windows on a fatter, rounder body.
The G200 is the shorter, older design with smaller winglets; the G280 is longer with taller, more prominent winglets.
The Hawker 4000 has plain wingtips; the G280 has large winglets.
